value.body: A biotech associate carries out lab and production work in biotechnology companies, such as cell culture, assays, fermentation and quality testing. Employers include biopharma and vaccine makers, diagnostics firms, contract research labs and research institutes. A typical day involves following standard procedures at the bench, recording results carefully, and keeping equipment and documentation ready for audits.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Sc/M.Sc in Biotechnology, Microbiology or Life Sciences

items.label: Key rules
items.value: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join as trainee or junior associates in QC, production or R&D labs. Many employers prefer an M.Sc; hands-on internships and GMP training help B.Sc graduates.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is often in shifts at manufacturing sites.
An M.Sc or Ph.D. opens research-focused roles.
Next roles: senior associate, QA/QC officer, scientist, regulatory affairs.
